title: Sargon of Akkad
description: Founder of the Akkadian empire. Person record added by the CFAH pass for CFAH's reign dates; dates are as printed in the CFAH paper cited.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year.

reign.date: earliest … 1642 B.C. … latest date for his death in 1553 B.C.
reign.citation: Griffith & White, "Chronological Framework of Ancient History. 5: The Babylonian Dynasties of Berossus," ARJ 16 (2023): 635–670, section "8. Sargon of Akkad and Pepi I"
reign.note: From the Sumerian King List durations: "the earliest date for the start of Sargon’s reign in the year 1642 B.C., and the latest date for his death in 1553 B.C." The OSF preprint CFAH-15 dates the start of his reign to 1619 BC (AP-92; open question I8).

free_source_links.locator: "8. Sargon of Akkad and Pepi I"
